name: Gmail
tagline: Search and read your email, sort it, and write drafts for you to send.
summary: Search and read the user's Gmail, write drafts and replies, and label, archive or trash mail. It cannot send: a draft waits in Gmail for the user to send it. Labels, archiving, trash and spam only after the user approves.
can: Search and read the mail in the account it signs in to
Write drafts and replies, which wait in Gmail for you to send
Label, archive, trash or mark as spam, only after you approve it
